messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have direct access to live clocks, so I can’t tell you the precise minute‑by‑minute time right now.  
But here’s what you need to know:

| Location | Standard Offset | Daylight Saving Offset |
|----------|-----------------|------------------------|
| **New York City** | UTC–5 hours (Eastern Standard Time) | UTC–4 hours (Eastern Daylight Time – usually observed from the second Sunday in March until the first Sunday in November) |

If you’re looking at Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), just subtract 5 hours during standard time or 4 hours when daylight saving is active. For example, if it were 18:00 UTC, NYC would be 13:00 EST or 14:00 EDT depending on the season.

For the most accurate result, check your device’s world‑time feature, a reliable online world clock, or simply look at the built‑in clock on your computer/phone set to “America/New_York.”
